question: Which of the following rivers flows north of the Tropic of Cancer in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Yamuna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Yamuna River** is one of the major rivers in India and a significant tributary of the **Ganges River**.
 
• It originates from the **Yamunotri Glacier** in the **Himalayas**, located in the **Uttarkashi district of Uttarakhand**.
